notes: This is how a declared power limit actually reaches the MLCommons database: as free text in a Notes column, not as a structured field, and only in rounds up to v6.0. In v6.1 the Notes column is uniformly 'N/A' for every LLM row and design_power_watts is null for all 492 rows, so a v6.1 result carries NO power information of any kind. The consequence for anyone comparing across rounds: the v6.1 B300 result (109277 tok/s) and this v5.1 H200 result (34548.2 tok/s) differ by 3.2x, but only the older one has a stated power limit at all, and neither has a measured wattage. The comparison across those two rounds is not a clean hardware comparison and cannot be made into one from the published data.
